mix_proposal.walk: Quiet selected footfalls only; do not sound every leg or every visible spider.
mix_proposal.launch: Prioritize the short attack transient over movement.
mix_proposal.haul: One cue per visible pull; stop instantly when hauling ends; no continuous loop.
mix_proposal.hunger: Occasional vocal on the spider holding the hero, not every pull or all spiders.
mix_proposal.voice_budget: Propose two shared spider voices, with capture/escape priority over walk/hunger.
mix_proposal.omit_by_default: No ambient cocoon bed or repeated struggle vocals in the busy mix.
mix_proposal.status: Recommendations only; cooldowns, priorities and mix require gameplay validation.
